args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, while v2.3.0 (and v2.2.9) were healthy.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — in all regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001): Documented the failure of v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that root-cause investigation of the v2.3.1 regression is ongoing. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: The rollback to v2.3.0 is a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
